summary: Frontend UI regression for KNDatePicker migration (46 replacements this session). Logged in as admin@kainnusantara.id, entity KSC. Verified: no <input type="date"> remaining in frontend/src (grep clean, only comment in KNDatePicker.jsx). All KNDatePicker instances render with data-testid `{id}`, popover opens with data-testid `{id}-popover` and closes after selection. ESC closes popover WITHOUT closing parent modal (verified on Journal Entry modal and Employee drawer). clearable=false correctly hides the `{id}-clear` button (verified on fs-pl-start and attendance-date). min= constraint disables prior dates in calendar (verified on leave-form-to using leave-form-from as min → 5 disabled buttons). Data-testid presence + popover interaction verified on: visits-date-from/to (Penjualan → CRM → Kunjungan), fs-pl-start/end, fs-bs-asof, cf-start/end, eq-start/end (Keuangan → Laporan tabs fs-tab-pl/bs/cf/eq), je-date (Buku Besar → Jurnal Baru), attendance-date, leave-form-from/to (hub-tab-hr-leave → leave-create-button), overtime-form-date (hub-tab-hr-overtime → overtime-create-button), employee-dob-input, employee-joindate-input (SDM → Karyawan → create-employee-button). Zero console errors / pageerrors across all navigated screens. Total KNDatePicker usages in codebase: 79 across 63 files.

Source-level presence confirmed via grep for all above; interactive coverage limited by demo data / deep flows
critical_code_review_comments: KNDatePicker: onChange fires with format(d, 'yyyy-MM-dd') on select — good; but clear button uses e.preventDefault() then setOpen(false) which is correct since it's absolute-positioned INSIDE PopoverTrigger's wrapper — if PopoverTrigger propagates its click, popover may still toggle on some browsers. Not observed in tests; keep as note.

KNDatePicker exposes only data-testid on the trigger button and popover content; the clear icon uses `${testId}-clear` but has no visible focus ring/aria state beyond aria-label — accessible enough. No missing testids.
min/max props parse ISO strings but do not validate ordering (min > max) — if a caller passes contradictory values all days become disabled. Consider guarding. Not a blocker.

success_rate.frontend: 100% of exercised pickers pass (13/13 interactive checks; remaining pickers verified via static grep only)
